verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents a single API covering 100M+ products from 25,000+ brands. Agents can reach it via MCP without an API key, pay per call via MPP with no signup, or use free self-service API keys, so no partnership is needed. SDK and CLI access are also documented. Community hands-on reports confirm searches run but describe poor result relevance and ignored price filters, which lowers quality without contradicting the access capability. Missing for 10: independent evidence of reliable, relevant cross-merchant search results; a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can programmatically search products or services across merchants — keylessly or with self-service credentials, no private partnership required

citations.quote: Access 100 million+ products from 25,000+ brands through one API.
You can use it without writing any code, and without an API key.
Agents can pay via MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) — no API key or signup required.
No OAuth flow is required for the public product data API. API keys are free to create.
